The '''1965 FA Charity Shield''' was the 43rd [[FA Community Shield|FA Charity Shield]], an annual [[association football|football]] match played between the winners of the previous season's [[Football League First Division|First Division]] and [[FA Cup]] competitions. The match was played on 14 August 1965 at [[Old Trafford]], [[Manchester]] and contested by [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]], who had won the [[The Football League 1964–65|1964–65 First Division]], and [[Liverpool F.C.|Liverpool]], who had won the [[1964–65 FA Cup]]. The teams played out a 2–2 draw and shared the Charity Shield.<ref>{{Cite web | url = https://www.rsssf.org/tablese/engsupcuphist.html | title = England – List of FA Charity/Community Shield Matches| website = [[RSSSF]] | access-date= 15 February 2012 }}</ref>
